visual_name: Day in the life, part twenty six: still bald (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js greenhouse with glass walls and potting benches, box-built bald character in a bucket hat, offers inbox with stamps / shampoo chat / interests chips / find deals with fit note pages, seedling, seeds, soil, trowel, shampoo and stroller props, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.4 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a bald gardening creator gets offered shampoo, a stroller and car wax; he says yes to the shampoo and they ask him to show the hair. Then YourBrand: pick your interests once, every campaign shows whether it fits, a wrong fit is flagged before you apply. So he applies where he fits: seeds, soil, a very nice trowel. Still bald.
